column1: # Meridian Freight Pte Ltd — Depot Portal cluster reconnaissance checklist
# Synthetic dataset for KCNA Lab 01. Consumed as ConfigMap `recon-checklist`.

column3: Which cluster and user is my context bound to?
Do client and server minor versions match?
How many nodes are Ready and what is their role?
Which API groups and versions does the server serve?
Which resource kinds exist and are they namespaced?
What fields may a Pod spec legally contain?
Which namespaces already exist on this cluster?
Is this namespace bounded by a quota?
Are container defaults injected by a LimitRange?
What HTTP request does kubectl actually send?
What does the API server store for one object?
